employee-self-service.name: People Employee, self-service
employee-self-service.description: Own profile, leave booking, personal attendance, timelogs, and HR helpdesk cases.

manager.name: People Manager
manager.description: Employee self-service plus team visibility, shift schedules, and approval handling.

hr-admin.name: People HR Admin
hr-admin.description: Operational HR administration: employee form records, leave policy setup, attendance rules, holidays, org structure, and reports. Excludes salary, benefits, and destructive settings deletes.

employee-lookup.name: Employee lookup and profile inspection
employee-lookup.description: Find an employee by name, email, or employee ID, resolve the erecno, and read detailed profile fields.

employee-record-maintenance.name: Create or correct employee and HR form records
employee-record-maintenance.description: Resolve a form, its fields, picklists, and lookups, then create or update records. Covers corrections such as a wrong date of joining.

leave-type-configuration.name: Configure and audit leave types
leave-type-configuration.description: Review configured leave types, inspect one policy in full, and add or change leave-type rules including applicability.

leave-booking.name: Book, preview, and cancel leave
leave-booking.description: Check balances, preview the balance impact, submit a leave request for an employee, and cancel an existing one.

leave-balance-reporting.name: Leave balances and absence reporting
leave-balance-reporting.description: Report booked versus remaining leave, list leave records across employees, and see who is absent.

holiday-calendar.name: Holiday calendar review
holiday-calendar.description: Inspect the holidays applicable to a user and the leave-type rules that govern holiday and weekend handling.

attendance-reporting.name: Attendance, working hours, and overtime reporting
attendance-reporting.description: Review payable days, worked hours, overtime, deviations, and daily punch details for one or many employees.

attendance-policy-configuration.name: Configure attendance and working-hour policy
attendance-policy-configuration.description: Read and change organization-wide working hours, round-off, grace, overtime carry-over, and scoped attendance policies.

attendance-regularization.name: Attendance regularization and correction
attendance-regularization.description: Check whether regularization is enabled, fetch valid reasons, submit a correction, and cancel or approve it.

shift-management.name: Shifts and team scheduling
shift-management.description: Inspect configured shifts, read employee shift mappings, and process shift change requests.

time-tracking.name: Project and job time tracking
time-tracking.description: Query jobs, log and correct hours, control the running timer, and submit timesheets.

remote-work-policy.name: Work from home and remote policy
remote-work-policy.description: Inspect remote work policies and balances, submit WFH requests, and approve them.

approvals-inbox.name: Approval inbox handling
approvals-inbox.description: List pending approvals or own requests across modules and approve or reject them.

hr-helpdesk.name: HR helpdesk cases
hr-helpdesk.description: Raise, triage, comment on, and resolve internal HR helpdesk tickets.

helpdesk-reporting.name: HR helpdesk reporting
helpdesk-reporting.description: Report open, escalated, and closed HR case volumes for a period.

onboarding.name: Candidate and employee onboarding
onboarding.description: Add candidates, trigger onboarding and workflows, resend invitations, and complete or reopen onboarding.

org-structure.name: Organization structure and directories
org-structure.description: Read and maintain legal entities, business units, divisions, departments, locations, and groups.

workforce-analytics.name: Workforce analytics and headcount
workforce-analytics.description: Report headcount by department, location, and designation, plus attrition and diversity distribution.

performance-management.name: Performance, KRAs, goals, and appraisals
performance-management.description: Maintain org and user KRAs, competencies, skills, goals, and read appraisal ratings.

okr-management.name: OKR objectives and key results
okr-management.description: Create and maintain organization, department, location, and user objectives with their key results.
